entities.summary: Robert Richard Rose is an American former professional baseball infielder and coach. He played for the California Angels in Major League Baseball (MLB), and for the Yokohama BayStars of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). During his playing career, he batted and threw right-handed and was listed at 5 feet 11 inches (1.80 m) and 170 pounds (77 kg). He later served as a hitting coach in Minor League Baseball.
